item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Origins, structure and functions of the curiae in ancient Rome (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-15 Diritto romano e fondamenti del diritto europeo

This project aims to investigate the institutional structure of the curiae in early Rome, including by testing the hypothesis that they predated the city’s foundation, as well as their role in the city’s emergence.Through an analysis of the ritual and legal elements from the historical period that persisted within the comitia curiata, the research will seek to clarify the dual nature of the curiae:as territorial districts and as kinship organisations.The military origins of the curiate assemblies and the probable dominance of the patres familiae in the decision-making processes of the archaic curiae will be examined in depth.The regressive method will be employed, tracing back from evidence…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Accusation in the Criminal Cognitio Extra Ordinem: Parties, Procedures and Transformations (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-15 Diritto romano e fondamenti del diritto europeo

The project aims at examining the structure and function of accusation in the criminal cognitio extra ordinem of the classical period,highlighting its differences from the accusatory model of the quaestiones. The research will focus on the persons entitled to bring an accusation, the procedures governing the initiation and conduct of the accusatio,the powers vested in the magistrate/official exercising the cognitio, and the relationship between private initiative and intervention by public authorities.Through an analysis of legal/literary sources, the project will investigate the extent to which the extra ordinem procedure retained elements of the traditional accusatory structure…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: From formal equality to gender anti-subordination: legal sources, courts and public policies in the Italian legal system and from a comparative perspective (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-11 Diritto comparato

The research aims to analyse the evolution of the principle of equality, from its formal and substantive dimensions to the progressive emergence of the principle of gender anti-subordination in contemporary constitutional law. Through an examination of legal sources, case law and public policies, the study seeks to explore the role of institutions in removing structural conditions of disadvantage and promoting gender equality, both in Italy and from a comparative perspective

item.description:

Field: Law / 12/GIUR-11 Diritto comparato

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Preparatory activities for the implementation of Local Public Transport Procurement procedures (Univ. BRESCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 14:00
Institution: Univ. BRESCIA, Brescia
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-06 Diritto amministrativo e pubblico

The assignment shall comprise study and research activities preparatory to the implementation of Local Public Transport Procurement procedures. For this purpose, the appointed person shall examine in depth the Italian and European legislation governing the planning and preparation of the procedures, with particular focus on its practical application, including in the context of the Brescia area. Particular attention shall be devoted to the principles and rules of Public Procurement Law and to relevant case law and judicial developments.
